I've rebuilt the routine diagram and the card layout. Typecheck, build and lint pass. Nothing is committed or pushed. For the screenshots I used a separate server on port 8811 with a copy of the state, LLM calls off, background jobs off, and all non-GET requests blocked except dry-run previews on that copy. That server is stopped now.

## Review: what was off and why
1. **Arrows between conditions read as a sequence.** The conditions are an AND list, so the arrows lied about the logic. When the row wrapped, line 2 started with an arrow pointing at nothing.
2. **Every card was a different size.** Each card grew to fit its text, so the eye jumped and the lane looked busy.
3. **Long drafted prose in big cards, each with an "Only if" or "And" title.** That meant six titles for one idea, and the conditions grabbed more attention than the steps.
4. **"0 matched" only on the last condition.** It didn't say whether one condition was blocking or all of them were.
5. **Two near-identical conditions were shown with no comment.** Lines 3 and 4 ("supplier offers stock now" and "reply offers immediate shipment from stock") were drafting noise the buyer had to spot alone.
6. **The guard box was louder than the steps.** The filled grey "Always" box outweighed Then, which is what the routine actually does.
7. **The left lane labels plus vertical rules felt like a form.** They took 80 px of width and added three more lines.
8. **The hint "Hover a step to remove it, drag to reorder" competed with the section title.** The hover controls already make that clear.
9. **The trust control sat above the diagram.** It asked "how much may it do?" before the user had seen what "it" is.
10. **On phone, every condition was a full card with an arrow.** One routine turned into a very long scroll.

## What changed
- **Three groups, arrows only between them** (When → Only if → Then), side by side on wide screens and stacked on phone.
  - **When:** the trigger as quiet text, with "14 open decisions now".
  - **Only if all of these hold:** one numbered checklist with hairline rows and smaller type. Each line has a remove button (shown on hover or focus, always shown on touch), and hovering a line shows the exact rule.
  - **Then:** the only boxed cards (the main focus), stacked in order with drag to reorder, "Add step" below, and "N match now" in the header.
- **Funnel:** each condition shows how many cases are still left after it, counted from the cases the page already has. It copies the matching logic in `routines.py` (the shipments trigger and the waiting-hours conditions can't be counted that way and fall back to the last test run). The line where everything stops is shown in ink, and zeros after it are hidden. One sentence explains it, e.g. "Right now 5 of 14 get as far as line 3, and none pass it."
- **Near-duplicates:** flagged as "Says nearly the same as line 3. Keep one". This uses word overlap within the same condition type. Clicking it runs the usual test-first preview, so nothing is saved without Apply.
- **Always:** now one quiet line with the shield, set off by a hairline.
- **Hint line removed.**
- **New order:** name and status → How it works → How much it may do on its own (trust control with its one-line explanation) → change in your words → Run now / Delete / Show the code. The trust control is hidden while a change is under review.

One limit: the counts are worked out in the browser, so they can drift from the server if `routines.py` changes, and for the "waiting" and "replies" triggers they are approximate. That is why the header says "match now" rather than "would act".

## Files
- `/Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony/web/src/components/routines/FlowGraph.tsx` (layout rewritten; editing logic and the small sample diagram kept)
- `/Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony/web/src/components/routines/funnel.ts` (new: the counts and the duplicate check)
- `/Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony/web/src/components/routines/RoutineCard.tsx` (new order, hint removed, passes today's cases to the diagram)
- `/Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony/web/src/components/Routines.tsx` (passes today's cases to each routine card)
